narratives.Overview:
## Parent

#4201

Set-level bind: [5556011390](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4201#issuecomment-5556011390) / successor lean [5555943410](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4201#issuecomment-5555943410). Companion recut: #4201.

## Recut (post-bind, 2026-09-06)

Locked from the set arc. Keep this issue. Split the AC. Trigger fixtures that close #3845 are host-neutral. Widget map and arc-mode:direct default wait on #4201 grok-bot detect. The arc thin router lives here, not on #4201.

## Summary

Make "run an arc" a first-class design-critique motion: reliable triggers on every host, plus Grok Bot widget consent and arc-mode:direct default once grok-bot detect exists. GitHub thread remains the durable completed-arc ledger.

## Two slices (do not couple them)

### A. Host-neutral triggers (closes #3845)

Trigger coverage: arc, run an arc, arc #N, run an arc on #N, plus existing design-critique / critique panel / mechanism-shaped triage.

- Positive fixtures for those phrases.
- Negative: bare "review" without a critique target must not select design-critique over review-cycle.
- This slice has no grok-bot dependency. It must not wait on #4201 detect.

### B. Grok Bot cockpit (depends on #4201)

- On grok-bot detect, default arc-mode:direct unless checkout tokens. Consume `parseOperatorRunPosture` (#4072). Do not write a second parser.
- No worktree for process-only critics. EXIT names ingest as a later operator verb -- no auto-ingest.
- Widget-map operator verbs after successor lean: Accept, Walk, Walk all, Retry differences, Post verified-claims table, Accept synthesis, Halt. Print only the verbs that apply (retry only if residual headings are named; walk only if a take is disagree). Chat short-forms remain valid.
- Widgets MUST show numbered Discuss and Back (#1470 / #1563).
- Plain-English first in main-chat; contract jargon in thread; summaries non-normative for downstream agents (#480).

Clearance stays on GitHub. Grok Bot is cockpit. Issue thread is ledger. Chips are not ingest clearance.

## Non-goals

- No auto-dispatch critics.
- Do not move clearance off GitHub.
- Contract stays SoT.
- Do not re-parse direct/checkout.
- Do not implement the host adapter (that is #4201).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Trigger fixtures close #3845 with no grok-bot dependency.
- [ ] Slice A may ship while #4201 is open; status:child is not a gate on trigger fixtures.
- [ ] Negative fixture: bare review does not steal from review-cycle.
- [ ] Direct default only after grok-bot detect; checkout tokens still win.
- [ ] Widget mapping preserves Discuss and Back; apply-set matches the contract (no retry on empty residual).
- [ ] Plain-English main-chat; ingest gated on completed-arc record.
- [ ] No normative body in the thin skill.
- [ ] #4201 pack list is the only other pointer at this router.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.

Refs: design-critique contract; design-critique skill; #3845; #3797/#3798; #4072; #1470; #1563; ADR-005/006; #4201.

- Design-critique skill triggers omit run an arc. #3845 is open.
- `parseOperatorRunPosture` matches direct / github-only / no worktrees (#4072).
- No `grok-bot` descriptor yet (#4201 recut). Slice B cannot fire until that detect exists.
- Deterministic questions require numbered Discuss and Back on host widgets (#1470 / #1563).
- Set-level pointer 5555930881 is history. Recut comment 5556092511 is the body revision.

## Stop 2

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-06T01:34:59Z)

model: grok-4.6
role: critic

Dispatch SHA: `20f9dfbda67746fc0367b4856cfeb016e6e96213`
Ceiling: 5556098786. Charter: refutation. Recut body. Target shape: single issue premise.

Verdict on the refutation target: **not refuted**. #3845 is open. Skill triggers omit "run an arc". `parseOperatorRunPosture` already exists. Slice B cannot run until #4201 detect exists. The split is the right cheap shape.

## `sharpens-framing` -- status:child on the whole issue couples the host-neutral slice to #4201

Evidence. Recut body: slice A has no grok-bot dependency. Slice B depends on #4201. This session added `status:child` to #4202. Set-level lean said child for (2), not for (1).

Concrete failure mode. Queue readers treat the whole issue as blocked on the parent adapter. Slice A (close #3845) waits on host work it does not need.

Disposition consequence. Keep Parent #4201 in the body. Drop `status:child` from this issue, or say in AC that slice A may ship while #4201 is open. Do not make child-of-4201 a gate on trigger fixtures.

## `footnote` -- Widget apply-set is now in AC; do not re-parse #4072

Body already: print only verbs that apply; consume `parseOperatorRunPosture`. Content-contract tests pin trigger strings on the skill, not live parent menus. Slice B is host wiring.

## Injection / swarm lens

Trigger phrases are untrusted input. Keep normative contract bodies out of the thin skill (already a non-goal). Widgets that omit Discuss/Back become an un-escapable consent UI (already in AC).

## Road not taken

Move slice A onto #3845 as the implement vehicle -- possible, but the recut already makes #4202 the closer. Merge slice B into #4201 -- hides the trigger gap again.

## Steelman

Steelman for one coupled issue: operators say "arc it" on Grok Bot, so triggers and widgets are one ship. That flips the child-label finding only if slice A is allowed to merge while #4201 is open. The AC line above is that permission. Without it, child-of-4201 is a silent gate.
